review: Task 125 is met. fill_transaction/2 now accepts a spec FillTransactionResult (confirmed on ethereum/execution-apis master src/schemas/transaction.yaml: required `tx` only, FilledTransaction is the unsigned *Unsigned union with no v/r/s/yParity) by injecting throwaway signature placeholders, running the existing from_json/1 path, then clearing those fields to nil. That keeps eth_getBlockBy* decoders strict. V1.t() now types v/r/s as integer() | nil (V2/V3/V4 already admitted nil); get_signature/1 treats nil as missing. Geth {raw, tx} still prefers raw and round-trips through Transaction.encode/decode. Unit tests cover both shapes and assert nonce/gas/fee survival; from_json/1 on V1–V4 still raises InvalidHex on a corrupt present signature.
